description: Keeps a seed global, initialising it from the input when it is zero. It then multiplies the seed's low 16 bits by 58925, stores the product as the next state and returns it in a 64-bit result.

name: set_keyboard_serial_state
description: Writes a constant to a global and rewrites another global to itself. The facts identify the keyboard serial register, which the body reaches only through the global.

name: translate_key_code_to_char
description: Looks up a keyboard code in a character table whose referenced text is the key row from the tilde to the backslash, and returns the character. Codes outside the table, or with the release bit set, yield zero.

name: extract_low_nibble
description: Returns the low four bits of a 16-bit register value.

name: setup_display_window_registers
description: Writes a sequence of display window, data fetch and bitplane control values, sets the bitplane modulo values to zero, then calls a copper-list start routine and two more routines.

name: swap_two_global_longwords
description: Exchanges two global longwords through a temporary value.

name: build_plane_pointer_table
description: Writes three high and low word pairs into a pointer table, each pointer 8000 bytes beyond the previous one, starting from a global base.

name: poll_routine_until_zero
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns zero, then returns.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Enters an unconditional infinite loop with no operations, so execution never returns from this point.

name: wait_and_reset_flag
description: Waits until a counter global reaches two or more, then clears it and returns.

name: open_graphics_library_setup
description: Sets copper and interrupt-related globals, then opens the graphics library through a system library call. On success it stores the library base and sets a flag; on failure it halts.

name: setup_copper_and_interrupts
description: Writes DMA and interrupt enable values, stores a routine pointer and copper list setup, starts the copper through a routine, then writes a final DMA control value.

name: acknowledge_vblank_interrupt
description: Increments a counter global, calls routines, then writes the vertical-blank request bit to the interrupt request register to acknowledge that interrupt.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Sets the copper list pointer to the address of a global block, writes two constants to globals, and then starts the copper list through the copper start routine.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Sets the copper list pointer to a global block address, records the same address in a second pointer global, writes two constants and starts the copper list through the copper start routine.

name: write_dma_control_value
description: Writes a single constant to a global that the facts associate with the DMA control register.

name: configure_interrupt_dma
description: When a pending mask is nonzero, it merges the mask into a shadow word and writes the mask in both set form and clear form to the DMA and interrupt registers, then clears the pending mask.

name: mask_interrupt_flags
description: Writes a constant with the audio channel bits set, derives a four-bit field from it and clears matching bits in a shadow word, writing the field back when none were set. The facts list the interrupt enable, DMA and interrupt request registers.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The recovered code is bad instruction data, so control flow is truncated at once and no behaviour can be recovered.

name: accumulate_global_delta
description: Reads a global, writes it back unchanged and adds the difference between the old and new values to a counter. In the recovered body that difference is always zero.

name: toggle_global_top_bit
description: Sets a global to one when bit six is clear and to zero otherwise, then sets or clears bit seven of it so the top bit toggles. The facts list a CIA register group.

name: clear_eight_thousand_longwords
description: Writes zero to 8000 consecutive longwords starting at a pointer held in a global.

name: clear_strided_longword_rows
description: Clears seven longwords out of every ten, across 800 rows, starting from a fixed address.

name: call_routine_count_times
description: Calls one routine once for each step of a count, running from the input value down to zero inclusive.

name: add_byte_with_carry_chain
description: Adds a small value to a byte. When the sum reaches 104 it subtracts 10 and carries one to the preceding byte, repeating while carries occur, then sets a global to two.

name: empty_routine
description: Does no work and returns immediately, so calling it has no effect. The recovered body is a bare return.

name: handle_space_or_s_key
description: On a space input it skips following spaces, waits for a flag global and sets a counter to two. When the flag is set and the input is the letter s with a counter below a limit, it calls a routine.

name: copy_table_triple_into_record
description: Looks up three longwords in a table indexed by a global value times four and stores them into a record, with the third value offset by the first.

name: empty_routine
description: Does no work and returns immediately, so calling it has no effect. The recovered body is a bare return.

name: call_routines_if_flags_clear
description: Calls five routines, then calls one more when a record byte at one offset is zero, and calls a final routine when a second record byte at another offset is zero.

name: empty_routine
description: Does no work and returns immediately, so calling it has no effect. The recovered body is a bare return.

name: call_routines_with_offset_arg
description: Calls three routines with its register arguments passed through, and makes one of the calls with an argument reduced by 196608.

name: setup_blit_four_plane_pointers
description: Writes fixed blitter control and mask values, then writes four plane pointers, modulo and size values, stepping the two source pointers by 8000 bytes per plane.

name: call_routines_with_saved_argument
description: Calls routines with a saved register argument, and calls two of them only when the matching record bytes are zero.

name: call_routine_with_temp_pointer
description: Saves a pointer global, sets it to a fixed address, calls a routine, then restores the saved value.

name: call_routines_then_swap_longs
description: Calls two routines, then exchanges two global longwords.

name: call_routine_with_reset_pointer
description: Points a global at a fixed address, calls a routine, then sets the same global back to that address.

name: call_routine_for_each_char
description: Walks a null-terminated string through an address register and calls a routine for each character before returning.

name: draw_text_glyph_with_newline
description: Maps a character to a glyph pointer, handling space, line feed, a control code that clears seventeen rows and carriage return separately. It calls a routine for each glyph and advances the cursor by eight units.

name: call_four_routines_per_row
description: Runs 95 rows, calling four routines in sequence on each row.

name: setup_blit_row_pointers
description: Writes fixed blitter control and mask values, then loops over four plane pointers stepped by 8000 bytes and writes a size value derived from an input word.

name: configure_blit_from_pointer
description: Writes fixed blitter masks, control and modulo values, a source pointer taken from a global and a fixed destination, then sets the size register to a fixed value.

name: write_dma_control_value
description: Writes a single constant to a global that the facts associate with the DMA control register.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Calls a routine, then copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global.

name: load_color_registers_from_block
description: Copies sixteen words from a global block into the colour registers and writes a value to a global. The entry's facts also list a DMA control register.

name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one routine sixteen times, counting down from fifteen.

name: xor_pixel_bit_into_planes
description: Waits for two routine-returned values to pass their thresholds, then XORs one bit, chosen from a low-nibble value, into a word of each of three bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: copy_longword_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a pointer global to a second pointer global, then copies 8001 longwords from one buffer to the other.

name: copy_longword_block_to_buffer
description: Copies 8001 longwords from one buffer pointer to another.

name: clear_four_plane_word_rows
description: Clears one word in each of four plane regions spaced 8000 bytes apart, across 104 rows of 14 words starting from a fixed address.
